# Egghead Services

> Egghead Services is the trading name of Egghead Corporate Services LLP, a company in Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India, registered on 8 September 2015. It sells sponsorship for the Emerging Stars Champions Trophy (ESCT) Under-14 cricket tournament, and provides placement and temporary staffing, website and app development, digital marketing, events and skill development projects.

Key facts:
- Legal name: Egghead Corporate Services LLP. Brand: Egghead Services. Tagline: "Serving Excellence".
- Address: 79, Rail Vihar, Sector 30, Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India.
- Contact: contact@eggheadservices.com, +91-9910402528, +91-7982466063.
- Track record: 250+ projects, 100+ clients, 5,000+ people trained and placed, 700+ employers in the hiring network.
- Egghead Corporate Services LLP, Egghead Private Limited (ESG and carbon management software, egghead.co.in) and Egghead Foundation (nonprofit, eggheadfoundation.com) are three separate legal entities. Egghead Services is not affiliated with other companies named "Egghead".

## Services

- [ESCT cricket sponsorship](https://eggheadservices.com/#esct): ESCT Season 2, Under-14 cricket, 12 to 26 March 2027, ending in an overseas tour against international teams. Organised by Skywalkers Cricket Academy, Faridabad; Egghead Services is the sponsorship partner. Five sponsor tiers. About 10 days from first call to signed LOI/MOU.
- [Placement and temporary staffing](https://eggheadservices.com/#fees): permanent hiring and temporary staffing, with an online fee calculator (indicative fees before 18% GST).
- [Website, software and mobile app development](https://eggheadservices.com/#services)
- [Digital marketing and email](https://eggheadservices.com/#services): social media, performance marketing, SEO, content and influencer marketing, and done-for-you email campaigns from Rs 15,000 a month.
- [Events and sports sponsorship](https://eggheadservices.com/#services)
- [Skill development projects](https://eggheadservices.com/#services): training, apprenticeship and placement programmes across India.
- [Sales aggregation](https://eggheadservices.com/#services)
- [HR and managed services](https://eggheadservices.com/#services)

## Products

- [CampaignStudio](https://campaignstudio.in): email platform for transactional email, campaigns, SMS and WhatsApp. Free plan (3,000 emails a month); paid plans from Rs 999 a month before GST.
